arguments.analyst: Historical O rows: conservative/charge-preserving edits (I161L, I136L:V163A, E34K:K107R, I188L) stay bright (3.53–3.75), while R73H:I128N:N164S reaches 3.87; drastic multi-site hydrophobic swaps collapse (O4, O5 ~1.3). Menu candidates with conservative or single-residue content should retain high brightness.
arguments.hypothesis: Brightness is preserved by conservative substitutions at buried/structural positions and by basic-arginine retention (K107R, K156R), whereas disruptive nonconservative multi-edits lower it; hence I136V, K107R, K156R, and Y92F-containing candidates score near the observed bright range (~3.5–3.9).

decision.analyst: Historical O rows: conservative/charge-preserving edits (I161L, I136L:V163A, E34K:K107R, I188L) stay bright (3.53–3.75), while R73H:I128N:N164S reaches 3.87; drastic multi-site hydrophobic swaps collapse (O4, O5 ~1.3). decision.hypothesis: Brightness is preserved by conservative substitutions at buried/structural positions and by basic-arginine retention (K107R, K156R), whereas disruptive nonconservative multi-edits lower it; hence I136V, K107R, K156R, and Y92F-containing candidates score near the observed bright range (~3.5–3.9).
decision.critic: Predictions are model-fitted, not measured; C23's uncertainty is highest and O3 shows multi-edits can reach 3.87, so ranking may mislead.
